pidfile.description: Full path and filename for storing the process ID of the running HOPM.

command_interval.description: Interval to check command queue for timed out commands.

negcache_rebuild.description: How long between rebuilds of the negative cache.

dns_fdlimit.description: Amount of file descriptors to allocate to asynchronous DNS.

dns_timeout.description: Amount of time the resolver waits until a response is received from a name server.

realname.description: Text to appear in the 'realname' field of HOPM's /whois output.

username.description: Username if you don't have an identd running.

server.description: Hostname (or IP address) of the IRC server which HOPM will monitor connections on.

port.description: Port of the above server to connect to.

tls.description: Whether to use TLS when connecting to the above server.

tls_hostname_verification.description: Checks if the host name defined above matches the identity in the certificate.

readtimeout.description: Defines time in which bot will timeout if no data is received.

reconnectinterval.description: Interval in how often we try to reconnect to the IRC server.

oper.description: The username and password needed for HOPM to oper up.

mode.description: Mode string that HOPM needs to set on itself as soon as it opers up.

away.default: I'm a bot. Your messages will be ignored.
away.description: If this is set then HOPM will use it as an /away message as soon as it connects.

channel_name.description: Channel name. Local ('&') channels are supported if your ircd supports them.

kline.default: KLINE 180 *@%i :Open proxy found on your host.
kline.description: The command used when an open proxy is confirmed.

fd.description: Maximum file descriptors this scanner can use.

max_read.description: Maximum data read from a proxy before considering it closed.

timeout.description: Amount of time before a test is considered timed out.

target_ip.description: Target IP to tell the proxy to connect to.

target_port.description: Target port to tell the proxy to connect to.

ircd_hostname.description: Hostname used in target_string NOTICE lines to reduce false positives.
